messages:
abby_cs: Heads-up — AuroraHealth wants to onboard a private clinical summarizer model (13B) into Private. Main asks: PHI-safe handling, patient consent capture, Cloud KMS/HSM integration, full evals on our safety suite, and SLA + renewal discount tied to uptime. Sales flagged this as a possible renewal risk if onboarding slips.

sam_solutions: Thanks. Do we know data residency? will they host data in their VPC or expect our private tenant in their region?

abby_cs: They said data must remain in their GCP VPC and they want Cloud KMS + customer-managed keys. Long term they might request an on-prem package. Sales noted they expect launch within 6 weeks.

raj_security: Ok — we'll need to run the PHI checklist and a short threat model. Also confirm consent UI flow and audit log retention period. @devon_pse can you scope the HSM / keywrap integration effort?

devon_pse: I can scope it. Quick Q: do they want token-level redaction or policy-based masking? They pasted a sample consent line: ```I consent to AuroraHealth using de-identified portions of my records for summarization.``` We should suggest stronger consent language (explicit mention of storage, retention, and ability to revoke).

lina_ops: For Private deployment we support customer-managed KMS + BYOK HSM. We'll need ~1 week lead time to provision connectors and a runbook for key rotation. Also need to confirm log export (audit events) and retention settings.

sam_solutions: Recommend a 2-week safety eval window on their internal prompts. Need their test dataset + signed NDA before we run it. Can we do a canary after evals?

abby_cs: I'll ask for the eval dataset and NDA today. They also requested a rollback/canary policy: canary at 5% traffic for 48h before a full rollout.

raj_security: Canary sounds fine but add automated revert triggers for any PHI-exfil alerts or high-severity PII detections. I'll add a detector rule and hook it to the observability alerts. Also they want audit logs forwarded to Splunk — confirm SIEM integration.

devon_pse: For the canary we'll use a routing policy like:
```
route {
  percentage: 5;
  model: clinical-summarizer-13b-v1;
  rollback_on_alert: true;
}
```
We'll instrument token-level cost and latency metrics and add a health probe for PHI detectors.

deploybot: Deploy pipeline scaffold created: https://redwood.internal/pipelines/aurora-consent-deploy — runbook at https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/aurora-consent-deploy

abby_cs: :thumbsup: I'll consolidate and send to the customer. Action items I have: request dataset + NDA, request KMS key ARN and KMS admin contact, confirm retention policy and desired SLA terms. Also marking this as HIGH renewal risk because the contract extension is contingent on timely launch.

sam_solutions: I'll set up an enablement session for their product + infra teams next Tuesday. @lina_ops please prepare the private-deploy checklist and KMS/HSM notes.

lina_ops: Got it — I'll post the checklist and a short ops playbook by EOD tomorrow.

abby_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll post updates after I hear back from the customer.
